[RTCT.4.3] **`realtime` absent.** A `.ds` file whose
resolved dialect does NOT include `realtime` MUST NOT carry
a `.dsrt`. If a sibling `<basename>.dsrt` exists without
`realtime` enabled, the compile MUST fail with
`DS_VALIDATE_COMPILE_DSRT_WITHOUT_REALTIME` — the `.dsrt` is
useless and probably a leftover from an earlier `realtime`
configuration; surfacing as an error guards against silent
ineffectiveness.
